items.title: Noodlophile Stealer Hides Behind Bogus Copyright Complaints
items.description: Noodlophile is targeting enterprises in spear-phishing attacks using copyright claims as phishing lures.

items.title: Noodlophile Malware Campaign Expands Global Reach with Copyright Phishing Lures
items.description: The threat actors behind the Noodlophile malware are leveraging spear-phishing emails and updated delivery mechanisms to deploy the information stealer in attacks aimed at enterprises located in the U.S., Europe, Baltic countries, and the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region. items.title: ERMAC Android malware source code leak exposes banking trojan infrastructure
items.description: The source code for version 3 of the ERMAC Android banking trojan has been leaked online, exposing the internals of the malware-as-a-service platform and the operator's infrastructure. [...]

items.title: Microsoft Windows Vulnerability Exploited to Deploy PipeMagic RansomExx Malware
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have lifted the lid on the threat actors' exploitation of a now-patched security flaw in Microsoft Windows to deploy the PipeMagic malware in RansomExx ransomware attacks. The attacks involve the exploitation of CVE-2025-29824, a privilege escalation vulnerability impacting the Windows Common Log File System (CLFS) that was addressed by Microsoft in April 2025,

items.title: Workday Breach Likely Linked to ShinyHunters Salesforce Attacks
items.description: The HR giant said hackers mounted a socially engineered cyberattack on its third-party CRM system, but did not gain access to customer information; only 'commonly available' business contact info was exposed.
